title: YopiNopi
tagline: Delete Bumble. Instead of waiting for that special one to text back, start swiping on crypto price predictions that actually respond in a day.
description: Meet YopiNopi – where dating app mechanics meet crypto predictions. We've taken the addictive swipe experience you love and turned it into something profitable. No more wasting time on bad matches; instead, swipe on price predictions, compete with fellow traders, and earn rewards for accurate calls. Build your prediction streak, climb the leaderboards, and join a community of traders who prefer green candles to red flags. Trading has never been this fun or social.
how_its_made:
YopiNopi is built with a focus on scalability, security, and user experience. Our architecture leverages Powerloom Protocol and their Generative Prediction Markets (GPM) service for reliable price data and market predictions. We've implemented account abstraction through Privy to create a frictionless onboarding experience, crucial for mass adoption.
The platform is deployed on Telegram Mini Apps, giving us instant access to Telegram's billion+ users while maintaining a native app experience. Our frontend utilizes Next.js 14 with Server Components for optimal performance. 

Our social features leverage Telegram's existing infrastructure while adding custom elements like social and viral mechanics. Like leaderboard, referral system and quests.
